title: Kaboom bomb + pickup colliders — ragdoll interacts with placed objects
notes: Continuation of the S136 arena-physics arc: floor + hard-blocks + soft-blocks now have static Rapier colliders so ragdoll bodies bounce off them. Bombs + pickups are still visual-only entities, so dead bombers' bodies clip straight through any bomb or powerup sitting on the floor. This sprint closes that gap.

Both bomb and pickup follow the soft-block pattern: write RigidBody3D{type:fixed} + Collider3D on spawn; entity removal at fuse-expiry / collect lets physics-sync-system's phase-1 release the Rapier body automatically (no extra teardown wiring needed — see TEST-SOFT-BLOCK-COLLIDER-CLEANUP-001 from S136).

Safety: alive bombers use grid-mover-system (no Rapier body) so the new static colliders don't break the existing kick/bump gameplay. The only thing that touches them is the dead bomber's ragdoll bodies.

stories.title: Bomb prefab gains a static Rapier collider so ragdolls bounce off
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/prefabs/bomb.prefab.json — add RigidBody3D{type:fixed} + Collider3D{kind:sphere,radius:0.175} (matches the 0.35-scale sphere visual). Bomb spawn tweens scale 0 → final but the collider stays at 0.175 from creation — the few-frame size mismatch is irrelevant because nothing collides with a bomb in its spawn-pop window. Cleanup: bomb-fuse-system's world.removeEntity at fuse=0 releases the body via physics-sync phase-1.
verification: acceptance: examples/kaboom-crew/prefabs/bomb.prefab.json gains RigidBody3D{type:fixed} + Collider3D{kind:sphere,radius:0.175}. The 0.175 radius matches the bomb's final visual (sphere geometry radius 0.5 × Transform.scale 0.35). engine:check passes; 268/268 kaboom unit tests green. Ragdoll bodies bounce off placed bombs; entity removal at fuse expiry releases the body via the existing physics-sync phase-1 path.

stories.title: Unit test: bomb spawn registers a Rapier body; removal releases it
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/bomb-placement-system.test.ts (extend the existing 'spawns a bomb' test) — assert RigidBody3D + Collider3D components are present on the placed bomb. Plus a fresh test that tick + world.removeEntity (mimicking fuse expiry) clears the body from the registry. Schema validation via engine:check ensures the prefab JSON stays valid.

stories.title: pickup-spawn-system writes static colliders on every spawned pickup
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/pickup-spawn-system.ts — alongside the existing Transform / MeshRenderer / GridPosition / GridOccupant / Pickup / ParticleEmitter writes, also setComponent RigidBody3D{type:fixed} + Collider3D{kind:box,size:[visual.scale[0], visual.scale[1], visual.scale[2]]}. Box covers all pickup mesh kinds (sphere/box/cylinder) with a slight rounding error that's invisible at this scale. removeEntity in pickup-collect-system releases the body via physics-sync phase-1.

stories.title: Unit test: spawned pickups carry RigidBody3D + Collider3D; collect releases
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/pickup-spawn-system.test.ts (or extend the existing 'spawns a pickup' test) — assert the new RigidBody3D + Collider3D components land on the pickup entity with size matching the visual. examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/pickup-collect-system.test.ts — assert the collected pickup's entity removal would release a body (component-level check; the actual Rapier release is covered by S136's physics-sync test).
